verdict.rationale: Sprinto's own integration docs say an integration helps it "map and check if the user with access offboards the organization" (sprinto-docs-37), so there is documented offboarding access-revocation checking. Access-check monitoring and access reviews are documented only by page titles (sprinto-docs-7, sprinto-docs-8). Nothing in the pack shows HR-synced onboarding checklists or proof that new hires completed training. missing for 10: HR-system sync driving onboarding/offboarding workflows, per-hire training completion tracking, checklist-style onboarding/offboarding evidence, substantive access-check documentation beyond titles, independent corroboration
